protectedRevelations: Comparative causal verdicts, intervention recommendations and objections resolved in full argument

scenes.title: The shift follows you home
scenes.viewerPurpose: Recognize work pressure following you home See the book connecting private feelings and social life
scenes.composition: A worker brings a changed shift into a quiet consultation
addOrChange: Remove floating distress symbols and keep an ordinary tired posture.

cues.narration: The shift ends, but the pressure follows you home.
cues.visualAction: The worker folds the shift sheet but keeps holding it.

cues.narration: The Illness Machine investigates how work, money, and institutions enter our mental lives.
cues.visualAction: Widen to the listening clinician with the schedule between them.

scenes.title: Where distress begins
scenes.viewerPurpose: Ask how conditions outside can affect suffering Picture the everyday pressures being examined
scenes.composition: An ordinary home contains overlapping work and care duties
addOrChange: Replace the income-success sequence with a timetable and an uncompleted household task.

cues.narration: It follows the paths between private suffering and the conditions surrounding it.
cues.visualAction: Show the person’s home around the private difficulty.

cues.narration: It looks at childhood hardship, insecure jobs, and the control people have over their working day.
cues.visualAction: Work hours overlap with the child’s care time.

scenes.title: Care and its conditions
scenes.viewerPurpose: Understand that biology and personal history still matter Question care that leaves harmful conditions intact
scenes.composition: Medical history and current working conditions remain equally present
addOrChange: Add a personal-history folder beside an unchanged rota, without implying one cause.

cues.narration: Biology and personal history remain essential parts of that picture.
cues.visualAction: Place the medical-history folder beside the work schedule.

cues.narration: The unsettling possibility is that a system offering care can also prolong distress.
cues.visualAction: The consultation continues while the difficult schedule remains unchanged.

scenes.title: Look beyond the symptom
scenes.viewerPurpose: Want a view beyond the consulting room Think about the life waiting after treatment
scenes.composition: A person leaves the clinic toward home and work
addOrChange: Add a plain doorway and a recognizable daily route, without a recovery transformation.

cues.narration: For anyone curious about mental health beyond the consulting room, the comparisons open a wider inquiry.
cues.visualAction: Place the open book beside the person outside the consultation.

cues.narration: What happens when getting better also means changing the life waiting outside the clinic?
cues.visualAction: Hold the route ahead while the person pauses at the doorway.
